Such drugs can be used for the treatment and prophylaxis of infec- tions with known viruses for which no antiviral treatment is available and, in the case of epidemics or pandemics, as a rapid response option while other countermeasures, such as vaccines and mAbs, are being developed12,13. In this Review, we discuss the rationale for the development of BSAs and provide a non-exhaustive overview of approved or experi- mental antiviral drugs active against viruses with an RNA genome. We also outline strategies for target discovery and accelerated clinical development. One drug to treat them all? The term ‘broad-spectrum’ antiviral has been widely used but lacks, to the best of our knowledge, a clear definition. Here, we propose instead to use the term ‘broader-spectrum’ antivirals and distinguish three categories: (i) cross-family BSAs with activity across unrelated viral families within or across a certain genome architecture, that is, negative-sense single-stranded RNA ((−)ssRNA), positive-sense single-stranded RNA ((+)ssRNA) or double-stranded RNA (dsRNA); (ii) pan-family BSAs that act across the different genera of a given viral family (for example, pan-paramyxovirus drugs); and (iii) intra-family BSAs, which are active against multiple serotypes and genotypes of a particular virus (for example, pan-serotype dengue virus (DENV) Introduction Viruses, whether known or yet to emerge (‘virus X’), remain a major threat to global health. Vaccines, monoclonal antibodies (mAbs) and antiviral drugs are each important and complementary in controlling viral infections. Vaccination has led to the eradication of smallpox, brought polio close to eradication and massively reduced disease and mortality associated with numerous viral infections, such as measles virus, mumps virus, rubella virus, influenza virus, severe acute respira- tory syndrome coronavirus 2 (SARS-CoV-2), hepatitis B virus (HBV) and human papillomavirus1–3. For several important human pathogens, such as HIV, hepatitis C virus (HCV), herpes simplex viruses (HSV), cytomegalovirus (CMV), rhinoviruses and many others, the devel- opment of highly effective vaccines has proved difficult or remains elusive, often despite decades of intensive effort. Therefore, it cannot be guaranteed that efficacious vaccines can always be developed when new threatening viruses emerge4,5. mAbs can offer immediate protection and are transforming the prophylaxis or treatment of certain acute viral diseases, such as those caused by the rabies virus6 and respiratory syncytial virus (RSV)7. They generally have an excellent safety profile and can be highly effective, although they require injections, are virus specific or variant spe- cific and can rapidly select for escape variants8,9. Like vaccines, mAbs can be developed only once a new pathogen has been identified and characterized. By contrast, small molecule antiviral drugs offer several distinct advantages. They can be administered orally and have the potential to cover a broader spectrum of viruses (Box 1) than vaccines and mAbs. Antiviral drugs have revolutionized the treatment of certain (chronic) viral infections such as those caused by either HIV, HBV, HCV, HSV-1 and HSV-2, and CMV. More recently, antiviral drugs have also become availa- ble against some other viruses including influenza viruses, SARS-CoV-2 and hepatitis delta virus. However, for the majority of the more than 200 known human pathogenic viruses, no antiviral drugs are available. Most of these viruses are RNA viruses — the focus of this Review — including many emerging and clinically important pathogens10–12. Baloxavir, an endonuclease inhibitor, inhibits influenza A and B viruses (family Orthomyxoviridae) but also, although much less potently, several members of the family Peribunyaviridae. Examples include neuraminidase inhibitors such as oseltamivir, zanamivir and peramivir that are active against both influenza A and B viruses (family Orthomyxoviridae). Nirmatrelvir is a reversible covalent, peptidomimetic Mpro inhibitor that inhibits human and animal coronaviruses belonging to different genera within the family Coronaviridae. analysis.scope_and_question: The review focuses on the development of broader-spectrum direct-acting antivirals (BSAs) against RNA viruses, with a particular emphasis on measles virus. The central question is whether BSAs can be developed to target multiple RNA virus genera, families, or even cross families, and how this approach can address the challenges of treating viral infections with limited therapeutic options.
analysis.evidence_base_and_review_method: The review is a systematic analysis of antiviral drug development, discussing the rationale for BSAs, their biological determinants, and clinical development frameworks. It does not report specific databases, search dates, or study counts, but it outlines the general approach to identifying and evaluating antiviral agents against RNA viruses.
analysis.consensus_and_key_conclusions: The review concludes that the development of BSAs is a promising strategy to address the unmet medical needs for antiviral treatments against RNA viruses, including measles virus. It highlights the importance of targeting conserved viral components to achieve broad antiviral activity and emphasizes the need for clinical frameworks to evaluate these drugs effectively.
analysis.controversies_and_evidence_gaps: The review notes that the term 'broad-spectrum' antiviral lacks a clear definition, and it proposes the use of 'broader-spectrum' instead. It also identifies gaps in the evidence, such as the limited preclinical data for many antiviral agents and the lack of robust clinical trials for some drugs, including those that were used in certain settings despite limited evidence.
analysis.research_and_practice_implications: The review suggests that the development of BSAs is critical for pandemic preparedness, as it allows for rapid response to emerging viral threats. It also highlights the importance of fixed-dose combinations and the need for further research into the biological determinants of antiviral activity across different RNA virus families.

analysis.summary_en: This review explores the development of broader-spectrum direct-acting antivirals (BSAs) against RNA viruses, with a focus on measles virus. It emphasizes the need for antiviral drugs that can target multiple viral genera or families, as traditional approaches have been limited to specific pathogens. The review outlines the rationale for BSAs, their biological determinants, and the clinical frameworks required for their evaluation. It also highlights the importance of these drugs in addressing unmet medical needs and enhancing pandemic preparedness. However, it notes the lack of a clear definition for 'broad-spectrum' antivirals and identifies gaps in preclinical and clinical evidence for many agents. The review concludes that BSAs are essential for combating both known and emerging RNA viruses, particularly those with high pandemic potential.

elements_zh.scope_and_question: 该综述的重点是针对 RNA 病毒的更广谱直接作用 麻疹病毒 (BSA) 的开发,特别是 麻疹病毒。核心问题是 BSA 是否可以开发用于靶向多个 RNA 病毒属、家族甚至跨家族,以及这种方法如何解决治疗选择有限的病毒感染的挑战。
elements_zh.evidence_base_and_review_method: 该综述是对 抗病毒药物 药物开发的系统分析,讨论了 BSA 的基本原理、其生物决定因素和临床开发框架。它不报告具体的数据库、搜索日期或研究计数,但概述了识别和评估 抗病毒药物 抗 RNA 病毒药物的一般方法。
elements_zh.consensus_and_key_conclusions: 审查得出的结论是,开发 BSA 是解决 抗病毒药物 治疗 针对 RNA 病毒(包括 麻疹病毒)未满足的医疗需求的一种有前景的策略。它强调了靶向保守病毒成分以实现广泛的 抗病毒药物 活性的重要性,并强调了有效评估这些药物的临床框架的必要性。
elements_zh.controversies_and_evidence_gaps: 审查指出,术语“广谱”抗病毒药物 缺乏明确的定义,建议使用“广谱”代替。它还确定了证据中的差距,例如许多 抗病毒药物 药物的临床前数据有限,以及某些药物缺乏可靠的临床试验,包括尽管证据有限但在某些情况下使用的药物。
elements_zh.research_and_practice_implications: 审查表明,BSA 的开发对于大流行防范至关重要,因为它可以快速应对新出现的病毒威胁。它还强调了固定剂量组合的重要性以及进一步研究不同 RNA 病毒家族中 抗病毒药物 活性的生物决定因素的必要性。

papers.title: Measles subacute sclerosing panencephalitis in children: past and present
papers.abstract: Эпидемиологическая ситуация по кори оставалась нестабильной в последние годы в России и в ряде других стран, сопровождалась подъемом заболеваемости в постковидном периоде, особенно в 2024 г. среди детей до 1 года, что является фактором риска развития крайней тяжелого и малокурабельного осложнения — коревого подострого склерозирующего панэнцефалита, как правило, манифестирующего неврологическими симптомами через 5–7 лет после перенесенной кори. Проведен анализ описательных и систематических научных литературных обзоров, а также других зарубежных и российских публикаций преимущественно за последние 10 лет, посвященных коревому подострому склерозирующему панэнцефалиту, вопросам этиологии, эпидемиологии, патогенеза и рисков развития после перенесенной кори, характерным клиническим симптомам, диагностическим критериям, а также методам лабораторной и инструментальной диагностики (электроэнцефалографии и магнитно-резонансная томографии). Представлены результаты международных исследований по оценке клинической эффективности различных схем терапии коревого подострого склерозирующего панэнцефалита у детей.

source_records.abstract: Эпидемиологическая ситуация по кори оставалась нестабильной в последние годы в России и в ряде других стран, сопровождалась подъемом заболеваемости в постковидном периоде, особенно в 2024 г. среди детей до 1 года, что является фактором риска развития крайней тяжелого и малокурабельного осложнения — коревого подострого склерозирующего панэнцефалита, как правило, манифестирующего неврологическими симптомами через 5–7 лет после перенесенной кори. Проведен анализ описательных и систематических научных литературных обзоров, а также других зарубежных и российских публикаций преимущественно за последние 10 лет, посвященных коревому подострому склерозирующему панэнцефалиту, вопросам этиологии, эпидемиологии, патогенеза и рисков развития после перенесенной кори, характерным клиническим симптомам, диагностическим критериям, а также методам лабораторной и инструментальной диагностики (электроэнцефалографии и магнитно-резонансная томографии). Представлены результаты международных исследований по оценке клинической эффективности различных схем терапии коревого подострого склерозирующего панэнцефалита у детей.

analysis.research_question_and_background: The study aimed to address the ongoing instability of measles epidemiology in Russia and other countries, particularly the rise in post-measles complications such as subacute sclerosing panencephalitis (SSPE) among young children, which often manifests with neurological symptoms years after infection.
analysis.study_design_and_population: The study analyzed descriptive and systematic scientific literature reviews, as well as other foreign and Russian publications from the last 10 years, focusing on SSPE, its etiology, epidemiology, pathogenesis, and risk factors following measles infection, particularly in children under one year of age.
analysis.methods: The research involved a review of international studies assessing the clinical effectiveness of various treatment regimens for SSPE in children, including laboratory and instrumental diagnostic methods such as electroencephalography and magnetic resonance imaging.
analysis.main_results: The study presented results from international research on the clinical effectiveness of different treatment schemes for SSPE in children, highlighting the challenges in managing this severe complication.
analysis.interpretation_and_novelty: The authors interpreted the findings as emphasizing the need for improved surveillance and early intervention strategies for SSPE, particularly in young children, and noted the novelty of the study in compiling recent data on this rare but severe condition.
analysis.scientific_and_public_health_significanc: The findings can inform public health strategies for measles surveillance and the development of targeted interventions to manage SSPE in children, especially in regions with unstable measles epidemiology.
analysis.limitations_and_evidence_strength: The study is limited by its reliance on existing literature reviews and does not include original data, resulting in moderate evidence strength for the clinical effectiveness of treatment regimens for SSPE.

analysis.summary_en: This study examines the ongoing instability of measles epidemiology in Russia and other countries, highlighting the increased incidence of post-measles complications such as subacute sclerosing panencephalitis (SSPE) among children under one year of age. The research reviews descriptive and systematic literature from the past decade, focusing on SSPE's etiology, epidemiology, and clinical management. It presents results from international studies on the effectiveness of various treatment regimens for SSPE, emphasizing the need for improved surveillance and early intervention. The authors interpret these findings as underscoring the importance of monitoring and managing SSPE, particularly in young children, and note the novelty of compiling recent data on this rare condition. The study's reliance on existing literature limits its evidence strength, providing moderate confidence in its conclusions.

elements_zh.research_question_and_background: 该研究旨在解决俄罗斯和其他国家 麻疹 流行病学 持续不稳定的问题,特别是 麻疹 后并发症的增加,例如幼儿中的 亚急性硬化性全脑炎 (SSPE),这些并发症通常在感染数年后出现神经系统症状。
elements_zh.study_design_and_population: 该研究分析了描述性和系统性的科学文献综述以及过去 10 年的其他外国和俄罗斯出版物,重点关注 SSPE、其病因、流行病学、发病机制 以及 麻疹 感染后的危险因素,特别是在一岁以下儿童中。
elements_zh.methods: 该研究回顾了评估各种 治疗 方案对儿童 SSPE 的临床有效性的国际研究,包括实验室和仪器诊断方法,如脑电图和磁共振成像。
elements_zh.main_results: 该研究介绍了不同 治疗 方案治疗儿童 SSPE 临床有效性的国际研究结果,强调了处理这种严重并发症的挑战。
elements_zh.interpretation_and_novelty: 作者将这些发现解释为强调需要改进 监测 和 SSPE 的早期干预策略,尤其是幼儿,并指出该研究在汇编有关这种罕见但严重的疾病的最新数据方面的新颖性。
elements_zh.scientific_and_public_health_significanc: 研究结果可为 麻疹 麻疹 监测 的公共卫生策略以及制定有针对性的干预措施来管理儿童 SSPE 提供信息,特别是在 麻疹 流行病学 不稳定的地区。
elements_zh.limitations_and_evidence_strength: 该研究由于依赖现有文献综述而受到限制,并且不包括原始数据,导致 治疗 方案治疗 SSPE 临床有效性的证据强度中等。

analysis_zh.research_question_and_background: 该研究旨在解决俄罗斯和其他国家 麻疹 流行病学 持续不稳定的问题,特别是 麻疹 后并发症的增加,例如幼儿中的 亚急性硬化性全脑炎 (SSPE),这些并发症通常在感染数年后出现神经系统症状。
analysis_zh.study_design_and_population: 该研究分析了描述性和系统性的科学文献综述以及过去 10 年的其他外国和俄罗斯出版物,重点关注 SSPE、其病因、流行病学、发病机制 以及 麻疹 感染后的危险因素,特别是在一岁以下儿童中。
analysis_zh.methods: 该研究回顾了评估各种 治疗 方案对儿童 SSPE 的临床有效性的国际研究,包括实验室和仪器诊断方法,如脑电图和磁共振成像。
analysis_zh.main_results: 该研究介绍了不同 治疗 方案治疗儿童 SSPE 临床有效性的国际研究结果,强调了处理这种严重并发症的挑战。
analysis_zh.interpretation_and_novelty: 作者将这些发现解释为强调需要改进 监测 和 SSPE 的早期干预策略,尤其是幼儿,并指出该研究在汇编有关这种罕见但严重的疾病的最新数据方面的新颖性。
analysis_zh.scientific_and_public_health_significanc: 研究结果可为 麻疹 麻疹 监测 的公共卫生策略以及制定有针对性的干预措施来管理儿童 SSPE 提供信息,特别是在 麻疹 流行病学 不稳定的地区。
analysis_zh.limitations_and_evidence_strength: 该研究由于依赖现有文献综述而受到限制,并且不包括原始数据,导致 治疗 方案治疗 SSPE 临床有效性的证据强度中等。

papers.title: Sự lan truyền dịch sởi theo không gian - thời gian và một số yếu tố liên quan tại Thành phố Hồ Chí Minh năm 2024–2025 Spatio-temporal spread of the measles epidemic and some related factors in Ho Chi Minh City (HCMC) during the 2024–2025 period
papers.abstract: Sởi là bệnh truyền nhiễm có khả năng lây lan rất cao, đặc biệt tại khu vực đông dân. Nghiên cứu mô tảsự lan truyền dịch sởi theo không gian - thời gian và một số yếu tố liên quan tại thành phố Hồ Chí Minh(TPHCM) giai đoạn 2024–2025 và các yếu tố nguy cơ. Nghiên cứu mô tả hồi cứu 9.699 ca sởi có địa chỉtại TPHCM, khởi phát từ 1/1/2024 đến 31/7/2025, trích từ hệ thống quản lý bệnh truyền nhiễm. Mô tả xuhướng thay đổi tỷ lệ mắc theo không gian-thời gian bằng QGIS. Xét mối liên quan bằng hồi quy nhị thức âmvà hồi quy tuyến tính. Tỷ suất mắc sởi nhóm 6-<9 tháng cao nhất với 3745 ca/100.000 dân. Dịch khởi pháttừ cửa ngõ giáp ranh tỉnh phía Tây–Tây Nam, có xu hướng lan đa hướng, rồi vào nội thành trước khi thoáilui. Có sự tương quan thuận giữa tỷ lệ mắc và số cơ sở giáo dục theo địa phương (r = 0,73, p < 0,001).Các xã, phường có KCN có tỷ suất mắc sởi cao gấp 11,96 lần so với các xã, phường không có KCN (IRR= 11,96; CI 95%: 4,73 - 37,27). Dịch sởi tại TPHCM 2024–2025 có đặc điểm khởi phát từ cửa ngõ có KCN,gia tăng đa hướng trước khi vào trung tâm. Mô hình giám sát theo không gian nên ưu tiên các điểm nóngcó nhiều yếu tố làm tăng nguy cơ (KCN, trường học).
papers.journal: Tạp chí Y học Dự phòng

analysis.summary_en: This study investigates the spatio-temporal spread of measles in Ho Chi Minh City during 2024–2025 and identifies related risk factors. It reports that the highest measles incidence was observed in the 6-<9 month age group, with 3745 cases per 100,000 people. A strong positive correlation was found between measles incidence and the number of educational institutions (r = 0.73, p < 0.001). Areas with industrial zones had 11.96 times higher incidence compared to those without (IRR=11.96; CI 95%: 4.73–37.27). The outbreak started at the western and southwestern border areas and spread in multiple directions before reaching the city center. The findings suggest that spatial surveillance models should prioritize high-risk areas with industrial zones and educational institutions for effective measles prevention strategies. The study is based on data from the infectious disease management system and uses QGIS and statistical regression methods for analysis, indicating high confidence in the results.

papers.title_zh: Sự lan truyền dịch sởi theo không gian - thời gian và một số yếu tố liên quan tại Thành phố Hồ Chi Minh năm 2024–2025 2024-2025年期间胡志明市(HCMC)麻疹疫情及一些相关因素
papers.source_body_en: Sởi là bệnh truyền nhiễm có khả năng lây lan rất cao, đặc biệt tại khu vực đông dân. Nghiên cứu mô tảsự lan truyền dịch sởi theo không gian - thời gian và một số yếu tố liên quan tại thành phố Hồ Chí Minh(TPHCM) giai đoạn 2024–2025 và các yếu tố nguy cơ. Nghiên cứu mô tả hồi cứu 9.699 ca sởi có địa chỉtại TPHCM, khởi phát từ 1/1/2024 đến 31/7/2025, trích từ hệ thống quản lý bệnh truyền nhiễm. Mô tả xuhướng thay đổi tỷ lệ mắc theo không gian-thời gian bằng QGIS. Xét mối liên quan bằng hồi quy nhị thức âmvà hồi quy tuyến tính. Tỷ suất mắc sởi nhóm 6-<9 tháng cao nhất với 3745 ca/100.000 dân. Dịch khởi pháttừ cửa ngõ giáp ranh tỉnh phía Tây–Tây Nam, có xu hướng lan đa hướng, rồi vào nội thành trước khi thoáilui. Có sự tương quan thuận giữa tỷ lệ mắc và số cơ sở giáo dục theo địa phương (r = 0,73, p < 0,001).Các xã, phường có KCN có tỷ suất mắc sởi cao gấp 11,96 lần so với các xã, phường không có KCN (IRR= 11,96; CI 95%: 4,73 - 37,27). Dịch sởi tại TPHCM 2024–2025 có đặc điểm khởi phát từ cửa ngõ có KCN,gia tăng đa hướng trước khi vào trung tâm. Mô hình giám sát theo không gian nên ưu tiên các điểm nóngcó nhiều yếu tố làm tăng nguy cơ (KCN, trường học).

papers.title: Đặc điểm dịch tễ bệnh sởi và một số yếu tố liên quan đến biến chứng của bệnh tại tỉnh Bình Định năm 2024 Epidemiological characteristics of measles and some factors related to measles complications in Binh Dinh province in 2024
papers.abstract: Bệnh sởi tái bùng phát tại Bình Định năm 2024 sau đợt dịch gần nhất năm 2019. Nghiên cứu nhằm môtả đặc điểm dịch tễ bệnh sởi và một số yếu tố liên quan đến biến chứng sởi. Nghiên cứu cắt ngang, hồicứu số liệu ca bệnh sởi (gồm ca nghi ngờ và ca xác định phòng xét nghiệm) khởi phát trong năm 2024tại Bình Định trên hệ thống giám sát sởi-rubella. Sử dụng mô tả tần số, tỷ lệ; phân tích đơn biến (sử dụngOR, 95% CI) xác định mối liên quan đến biến chứng bệnh sởi (có ít nhất 1 biến chứng tiêu chảy, viêm phổi,viêm tai giữa...). Kết quả năm 2024, tỉnh Bình Định ghi nhận 198 ca sởi (gấp 11,4 lần trung bình giai đoạn2019-2023), không ca tử vong. Ca mắc đạt đỉnh ở tuần 45 (25 ca). Bệnh ghi nhận cao nhất ở Quy Nhơn(57,7%, 109/198) và nhóm từ 18 tháng đến 5 tuổi (27,8%, 55/198). 71,2% (141/198) ca bệnh chưa tiêm/không rõ tiền sử tiêm vắc xin sởi. 35,4% (70/198) ca bệnh có ít nhất 1 biến chứng. Yếu tố liên quan biếnchứng: Ca bệnh dưới 5 tuổi (OR 2,1), chưa tiêm đủ 2 mũi vắc xin sởi (OR 3,6) và tiền sử nhập viện điều trịbệnh khác trước khởi phát 3 tuần (OR 3,2). Cần triển khai chiến dịch tiêm bổ sung và đánh giá miễn dịchđối với vắc xin sởi.
papers.journal: Tạp chí Y học Dự phòng

analysis.research_question_and_background: Nghiên cứu được thực hiện để mô tả đặc điểm dịch tễ của bệnh sởi và các yếu tố liên quan đến biến chứng tại tỉnh Bình Định năm 2024. Bệnh sởi đã tái bùng phát tại Bình Định năm 2024 sau đợt dịch gần nhất năm 2019.
analysis.study_design_and_population: Nghiên cứu là một nghiên cứu cắt ngang, thu thập số liệu từ các ca bệnh sởi (bao gồm cả ca nghi ngờ và ca xác định qua phòng xét nghiệm) khởi phát trong năm 2024 tại Bình Định thông qua hệ thống giám sát sởi-rubella. Tổng cộng có 198 ca bệnh được ghi nhận trong nghiên cứu.
analysis.methods: Nghiên cứu sử dụng mô tả tần số và tỷ lệ, kết hợp với phân tích đơn biến để xác định mối liên quan giữa các yếu tố và biến chứng bệnh sởi. Các chỉ số như OR (tỷ số cơ hội) và 95% CI (khoảng tin cậy 95%) được sử dụng để đánh giá mối liên hệ.
analysis.main_results: Năm 2024, tỉnh Bình Định ghi nhận 198 ca sởi, gấp 11,4 lần so với trung bình giai đoạn 2019-2023, không có ca tử vong nào được ghi nhận. Tỷ lệ ca mắc cao nhất ở Quy Nhơn (57,7%, 109/198) và nhóm từ 18 tháng đến 5 tuổi (27,8%, 55/198). 71,2% (141/198) ca bệnh chưa tiêm hoặc không rõ tiền sử tiêm vắc xin sởi.
analysis.interpretation_and_novelty: Kết quả cho thấy sự gia tăng đáng kể số ca sởi năm 2024 so với giai đoạn trước, đồng thời xác định các yếu tố nguy cơ liên quan đến biến chứng như độ tuổi dưới 5, chưa tiêm đủ 2 mũi vắc xin sởi và tiền sử nhập viện điều trị bệnh khác trong 3 tuần trước khởi phát.
analysis.scientific_and_public_health_significanc: Nghiên cứu cung cấp thông tin quan trọng về đặc điểm dịch tễ và các yếu tố nguy cơ của bệnh sởi tại Bình Định, hỗ trợ việc triển khai các chiến dịch tiêm chủng bổ sung và đánh giá miễn dịch đối với vắc xin sởi trong cộng đồng.
analysis.limitations_and_evidence_strength: Nghiên cứu dựa trên dữ liệu từ hệ thống giám sát, có thể bị giới hạn bởi độ chính xác của dữ liệu thu thập. Tuy nhiên, các kết quả được hỗ trợ bởi phân tích thống kê và tỷ lệ OR, cho thấy mức độ tin cậy cao.

analysis.summary_en: Nghiên cứu này mô tả đặc điểm dịch tễ của bệnh sởi và các yếu tố liên quan đến biến chứng tại tỉnh Bình Định năm 2024. Bệnh sởi đã tái bùng phát mạnh mẽ, với 198 ca ghi nhận, gấp 11,4 lần so với giai đoạn 2019-2023. Các ca mắc tập trung ở Quy Nhơn và nhóm từ 18 tháng đến 5 tuổi. Hơn 70% ca bệnh chưa tiêm hoặc không rõ tiền sử tiêm vắc xin sởi. 35,4% ca bệnh có biến chứng, bao gồm tiêu chảy, viêm phổi và viêm tai giữa. Các yếu tố nguy cơ được xác định bao gồm độ tuổi dưới 5, chưa tiêm đủ 2 mũi vắc xin và tiền sử nhập viện điều trị bệnh khác trong 3 tuần trước khởi phát. Nghiên cứu cung cấp bằng chứng quan trọng cho việc triển khai chiến dịch tiêm chủng bổ sung và đánh giá miễn dịch. Tuy nhiên, kết quả có thể bị giới hạn bởi độ chính xác của dữ liệu thu thập từ hệ thống giám sát.

papers.title_zh: Đặc điểm dịch tễ bệnh sởi và một số yếu tố liên quan đến biến chứng của bệnh tại tỉnh Bình 2024年平定省2024年麻疹流行病学特征及与麻疹并发症相关的一些因素
papers.source_body_en: Bệnh sởi tái bùng phát tại Bình Định năm 2024 sau đợt dịch gần nhất năm 2019. Nghiên cứu nhằm môtả đặc điểm dịch tễ bệnh sởi và một số yếu tố liên quan đến biến chứng sởi. Nghiên cứu cắt ngang, hồicứu số liệu ca bệnh sởi (gồm ca nghi ngờ và ca xác định phòng xét nghiệm) khởi phát trong năm 2024tại Bình Định trên hệ thống giám sát sởi-rubella. Sử dụng mô tả tần số, tỷ lệ; phân tích đơn biến (sử dụngOR, 95% CI) xác định mối liên quan đến biến chứng bệnh sởi (có ít nhất 1 biến chứng tiêu chảy, viêm phổi,viêm tai giữa...). Kết quả năm 2024, tỉnh Bình Định ghi nhận 198 ca sởi (gấp 11,4 lần trung bình giai đoạn2019-2023), không ca tử vong. Ca mắc đạt đỉnh ở tuần 45 (25 ca). Bệnh ghi nhận cao nhất ở Quy Nhơn(57,7%, 109/198) và nhóm từ 18 tháng đến 5 tuổi (27,8%, 55/198). 71,2% (141/198) ca bệnh chưa tiêm/không rõ tiền sử tiêm vắc xin sởi. 35,4% (70/198) ca bệnh có ít nhất 1 biến chứng. Yếu tố liên quan biếnchứng: Ca bệnh dưới 5 tuổi (OR 2,1), chưa tiêm đủ 2 mũi vắc xin sởi (OR 3,6) và tiền sử nhập viện điều trịbệnh khác trước khởi phát 3 tuần (OR 3,2). Cần triển khai chiến dịch tiêm bổ sung và đánh giá miễn dịchđối với vắc xin sởi.

papers.title: Một số đặc điểm dịch tễ học bệnh sởi tại Thanh Hoá, năm 2024-2025 Epidemiological characteristics of measles in Thanh Hoa province, 2024–2025
papers.abstract: Giai đoạn 2024–2025, số ca mắc sởi tăng mạnh tại tỉnh Thanh Hóa, tập trung ở nhóm chưa đến độ tuổitiêm chủng hoặc chưa được tiêm đầy đủ. Nghiên cứu nhằm mô tả một số đặc điểm dịch tễ học của cáctrường hợp mắc sởi tại Thanh Hóa. Thiết kế mô tả hồi cứu loạt ca bệnh được áp dụng với 1.587 trườnghợp ghi nhận qua hệ thống giám sát bệnh truyền nhiễm từ ngày 01/01/2024 đến 31/12/2025. Kết quả chothấy nam chiếm 58,7%; trẻ dưới 9 tháng tuổi (24,0%); nhóm từ 9 tháng đến dưới 10 tuổi (50,3%); nhóm từ10 tuổi trở lên (25,7%). Có 89,5% trường hợp mắc chưa được tiêm vắc xin sởi, trong khi tỷ lệ đã tiêm từ 2mũi trở lên chỉ chiếm 1,1%. Phần lớn ca bệnh cư trú tại khu vực đồng bằng và ven biển (80,5%); Sầm Sơncó tỷ lệ mắc cao nhất với 119,6 ca/100.000 dân. Số mắc tăng từ cuối năm 2024, tăng nhanh và đạt đỉnh ởtuần 17 năm 2025. Kết quả nghiên cứu gợi ý khoảng trống miễn dịch trong cộng đồng có thể là yếu tố gópphần vào sự gia tăng ca mắc sởi giai đoạn 2024-2025. Cần duy trì bao phủ vắc xin, phát hiện sớm ca bệnhvà triển khai tiêm chủng bù liều tại khu vực nguy cơ cao.
papers.journal: Tạp chí Y học Dự phòng

analysis.research_question_and_background: Nghiên cứu được thực hiện để mô tả các đặc điểm dịch tễ học của bệnh sởi tại Thanh Hóa trong giai đoạn 2024–2025, khi số ca mắc bệnh tăng mạnh, đặc biệt ở nhóm chưa đến độ tuổi tiêm chủng hoặc chưa được tiêm đầy đủ.
analysis.study_design_and_population: Nghiên cứu sử dụng thiết kế mô tả hồi cứu loạt ca bệnh, bao gồm 1.587 trường hợp ghi nhận qua hệ thống giám sát bệnh truyền nhiễm từ ngày 01/01/2024 đến 31/12/2025 tại tỉnh Thanh Hóa.
analysis.methods: Các trường hợp mắc bệnh được ghi nhận thông qua hệ thống giám sát bệnh truyền nhiễm, phân tích theo độ tuổi, giới tính và khu vực cư trú.
analysis.main_results: Kết quả cho thấy nam giới chiếm 58,7%, trẻ dưới 9 tháng tuổi chiếm 24,0%, nhóm từ 9 tháng đến dưới 10 tuổi chiếm 50,3%, và nhóm từ 10 tuổi trở lên chiếm 25,7%. Ngoài ra, 89,5% trường hợp mắc chưa được tiêm vắc xin sởi, trong khi chỉ có 1,1% đã tiêm từ 2 mũi trở lên.
analysis.interpretation_and_novelty: Nghiên cứu gợi ý rằng khoảng trống miễn dịch trong cộng đồng có thể là yếu tố góp phần vào sự gia tăng ca mắc sởi trong giai đoạn 2024–2025.
analysis.scientific_and_public_health_significanc: Kết quả nghiên cứu cung cấp thông tin quan trọng về sự phân bố nhóm nguy cơ cao cho bệnh sởi, từ đó hỗ trợ các biện pháp phòng ngừa và tiêm chủng bù tại khu vực có tỷ lệ mắc cao.
analysis.limitations_and_evidence_strength: Nghiên cứu dựa trên dữ liệu từ hệ thống giám sát bệnh truyền nhiễm, có thể bị giới hạn bởi độ chính xác của báo cáo và thiếu thông tin chi tiết về các yếu tố nguy cơ khác.

analysis.summary_en: Nghiên cứu mô tả đặc điểm dịch tễ học của bệnh sởi tại Thanh Hóa trong giai đoạn 2024–2025, khi số ca mắc tăng mạnh, đặc biệt ở nhóm trẻ chưa tiêm chủng đầy đủ. Các trường hợp được ghi nhận qua hệ thống giám sát bệnh truyền nhiễm, bao gồm 1.587 ca từ năm 2024 đến 2025. Kết quả cho thấy tỷ lệ tiêm chủng thấp, với 89,5% trường hợp chưa được tiêm vắc xin sởi và 1,1% đã tiêm từ 2 mũi trở lên. Nghiên cứu cũng ghi nhận sự phân bố ca bệnh theo độ tuổi và giới tính, với nhóm từ 9 tháng đến dưới 10 tuổi chiếm tỷ lệ cao nhất. Các kết quả gợi ý khoảng trống miễn dịch trong cộng đồng có thể là nguyên nhân dẫn đến sự gia tăng ca mắc. Nghiên cứu nhấn mạnh tầm quan trọng của việc duy trì bao phủ vắc xin và triển khai tiêm chủng bù tại khu vực có nguy cơ cao. Tuy nhiên, do dựa trên dữ liệu giám sát, nghiên cứu có thể bị giới hạn về độ chính xác và thiếu thông tin chi tiết về các yếu tố nguy cơ khác.

elements_zh.research_question_and_background: 本研究旨在描述2024–2025年Thanh Hóa省麻疹的流行病学特征,因为该期间病例数量显著增加,尤其是在未达到接种年龄或未完成接种的群体中。
elements_zh.study_design_and_population: Nghiên cứu sử dụng thiết kế mô tả hồi cứu loạt ca bệnh, bao gồm 1.587 trường hợp ghi nhận qua hệ thống giám sát bệnh truyền nhiễm từ ngày 01/01/2024 đến 31/12/2025 tại tỉnh Thanh Hóa.
elements_zh.methods: 病例通过传染病监测系统记录,并按年龄、性别和居住区域进行分析。
elements_zh.main_results: 结果显示男性占58,7%,婴儿占24,0%,9个月至10岁儿童占50,3%,10岁以上儿童占25,7%。此外,89,5%的病例未接种麻疹疫苗,而仅有1,1%的病例接种了2剂或以上。
elements_zh.interpretation_and_novelty: 研究提示,社区中的免疫空白可能是2024–2025年麻疹病例增加的一个因素。
elements_zh.scientific_and_public_health_significanc: 研究结果提供了关于麻疹高风险群体分布的重要信息,有助于在高发病率地区制定预防和补种措施。
elements_zh.limitations_and_evidence_strength: 本研究基于传染病监测系统的数据,可能受到报告准确性及缺乏其他风险因素详细信息的限制。

analysis_en.research_question_and_background: Nghiên cứu được thực hiện để mô tả các đặc điểm dịch tễ học của bệnh sởi tại Thanh Hóa trong giai đoạn 2024–2025, khi số ca mắc bệnh tăng mạnh, đặc biệt ở nhóm chưa đến độ tuổi tiêm chủng hoặc chưa được tiêm đầy đủ.
analysis_en.study_design_and_population: Nghiên cứu sử dụng thiết kế mô tả hồi cứu loạt ca bệnh, bao gồm 1.587 trường hợp ghi nhận qua hệ thống giám sát bệnh truyền nhiễm từ ngày 01/01/2024 đến 31/12/2025 tại tỉnh Thanh Hóa.
analysis_en.methods: Các trường hợp mắc bệnh được ghi nhận thông qua hệ thống giám sát bệnh truyền nhiễm, phân tích theo độ tuổi, giới tính và khu vực cư trú.
analysis_en.main_results: Kết quả cho thấy nam giới chiếm 58,7%, trẻ dưới 9 tháng tuổi chiếm 24,0%, nhóm từ 9 tháng đến dưới 10 tuổi chiếm 50,3%, và nhóm từ 10 tuổi trở lên chiếm 25,7%. Ngoài ra, 89,5% trường hợp mắc chưa được tiêm vắc xin sởi, trong khi chỉ có 1,1% đã tiêm từ 2 mũi trở lên.
analysis_en.interpretation_and_novelty: Nghiên cứu gợi ý rằng khoảng trống miễn dịch trong cộng đồng có thể là yếu tố góp phần vào sự gia tăng ca mắc sởi trong giai đoạn 2024–2025.
analysis_en.scientific_and_public_health_significanc: Kết quả nghiên cứu cung cấp thông tin quan trọng về sự phân bố nhóm nguy cơ cao cho bệnh sởi, từ đó hỗ trợ các biện pháp phòng ngừa và tiêm chủng bù tại khu vực có tỷ lệ mắc cao.
analysis_en.limitations_and_evidence_strength: Nghiên cứu dựa trên dữ liệu từ hệ thống giám sát bệnh truyền nhiễm, có thể bị giới hạn bởi độ chính xác của báo cáo và thiếu thông tin chi tiết về các yếu tố nguy cơ khác.

papers.title_zh: 2024-2025年清化省麻疹流行病学特征,2024-2025年
papers.source_body_en: Giai đoạn 2024–2025, số ca mắc sởi tăng mạnh tại tỉnh Thanh Hóa, tập trung ở nhóm chưa đến độ tuổitiêm chủng hoặc chưa được tiêm đầy đủ. Nghiên cứu nhằm mô tả một số đặc điểm dịch tễ học của cáctrường hợp mắc sởi tại Thanh Hóa. Thiết kế mô tả hồi cứu loạt ca bệnh được áp dụng với 1.587 trườnghợp ghi nhận qua hệ thống giám sát bệnh truyền nhiễm từ ngày 01/01/2024 đến 31/12/2025. Kết quả chothấy nam chiếm 58,7%; trẻ dưới 9 tháng tuổi (24,0%); nhóm từ 9 tháng đến dưới 10 tuổi (50,3%); nhóm từ10 tuổi trở lên (25,7%). Có 89,5% trường hợp mắc chưa được tiêm vắc xin sởi, trong khi tỷ lệ đã tiêm từ 2mũi trở lên chỉ chiếm 1,1%. Phần lớn ca bệnh cư trú tại khu vực đồng bằng và ven biển (80,5%); Sầm Sơncó tỷ lệ mắc cao nhất với 119,6 ca/100.000 dân. Số mắc tăng từ cuối năm 2024, tăng nhanh và đạt đỉnh ởtuần 17 năm 2025. Kết quả nghiên cứu gợi ý khoảng trống miễn dịch trong cộng đồng có thể là yếu tố gópphần vào sự gia tăng ca mắc sởi giai đoạn 2024-2025. Cần duy trì bao phủ vắc xin, phát hiện sớm ca bệnhvà triển khai tiêm chủng bù liều tại khu vực nguy cơ cao.

analysis_zh.research_question_and_background: 本研究旨在描述2024–2025年Thanh Hóa省麻疹的流行病学特征,因为该期间病例数量显著增加,尤其是在未达到接种年龄或未完成接种的群体中。
analysis_zh.methods: 病例通过传染病监测系统记录,并按年龄、性别和居住区域进行分析。
analysis_zh.main_results: 结果显示男性占58,7%,婴儿占24,0%,9个月至10岁儿童占50,3%,10岁以上儿童占25,7%。此外,89,5%的病例未接种麻疹疫苗,而仅有1,1%的病例接种了2剂或以上。
analysis_zh.interpretation_and_novelty: 研究提示,社区中的免疫空白可能是2024–2025年麻疹病例增加的一个因素。
analysis_zh.scientific_and_public_health_significanc: 研究结果提供了关于麻疹高风险群体分布的重要信息,有助于在高发病率地区制定预防和补种措施。
analysis_zh.limitations_and_evidence_strength: 本研究基于传染病监测系统的数据,可能受到报告准确性及缺乏其他风险因素详细信息的限制。

papers.title: Measles outbreak in a unique sociocultural context: epidemiological investigation and control measures in Northern Brazil, 2025

source_records.title: Measles outbreak in a unique sociocultural context: epidemiological investigation and control measures in Northern Brazil, 2025
Measles outbreak in a unique sociocultural context: epidemiological investigation and control measures in Northern Brazil, 2025

papers.priority_tier_reason: 高相关性，且具备高等级研究设计、全文证据或较强数据库/引用支持
papers.full_text: ABSTRACTAfter the recertification of measles elimination in Brazil, outbreaks associated with imported cases may occur in pockets of susceptible individuals, including communities with low vaccination coverage. This study describes an outbreak investigation conducted in 2025 in Campos Lindos, Tocantins State, Brazil. In total, 25 cases were confirmed, mostly among unvaccinated Old Believers (a traditional community of Russian origin) following viral introduction linked to international travel, with transmission occurring predominantly within the community. Outbreak response measures, including ring vaccination and active case finding, interrupted transmission after 12 weeks with no new cases. The rapid response was effective and reinforces the importance of identifying susceptibility pockets in the population to prevent measles reintroduction.KEYWORDS: Disease outbreaks, Measles, Vaccine hesitancy, Public health surveillance. MATERIALS AND METHODSA descriptive study was conducted among residents of Campos Lindos, a located in Tocantins State, northern Brazil (13°02’S, 46°46’W), with an economy predominantly based on agriculture and an estimated population of 8,653 inhabitants in 2025 5 . This study describes the outbreak, including the affected population, immunization aspects, surveillance activities, laboratory investigation, and prevention and control measures. Analysis ranged from July 18 to September 9, 2025, with retrospective case findings from June 18 onward and surveillance extending up to December 15 due to the international 12-week period required after the last reported case.This epidemiological investigation included interviews with suspected and confirmed cases, clinical sample collection, contact tracing and monitoring, active community case finding, review of medical records from the two Brazilian Unified Health System health services in the municipality, immunization activities, and training of health professionals. This investigation aims to identify the disease, the source of infection, and its transmission chain and to implement measures to control the outbreak and prevent community transmission.To control the outbreak and prevent new cases, immunization activities using measles-containing vaccines (MMR, MMRV, or MR) were carried out in individuals aged six months to 59 years according to the National Immunization Schedule. The strategies included (a) ring vaccination within 72 h after contact with suspected or confirmed cases, (b) vaccination sweep around confirmed cases (covering a minimum radius of five blocks in urban areas or five properties in rural areas), and (c) intensification of vaccination across the entire municipal population.To analyze vaccination in the context of the outbreak, vaccine doses administered from July to December 2025 in all age groups were considered according to records from the National Health Data Network 6 . Municipal vaccination coverage was evaluated in children aged 1 to <2 years following guidance from the Brazilian Ministry of Health, using the number of vaccinated children in this age group × 100 as the numerator and the corresponding estimated population as the denominator.Data were obtained from the Notifiable Diseases Information System 7 , the Laboratory Environment Manager, the Citizen Electronic Health Record, and the National Health Data Network vaccination dashboard. Descriptive analyses were performed using Microsoft Office, and the transmission chain was constructed on Go.Data 8 . Case definitions from the Brazilian Health Surveillance Guide were adopted 9 , and control actions followed Brazilian Ministry of Health protocols for outbreak response 10 , 11 .Ethical aspects followed the provisions of Law No 8,080/1990 (which regulates epidemiological surveillance actions in Brazil) and Resolution No 510 of April 7, 2016, of the National Health Council as this was an outbreak investigation conducted exclusively in response to an imminent public health risk, according to Brazilian regulations for public health surveillance activities. The confidentiality of those involved in the investigation was ensured (no individual identification). RESULTSFrom June 24 to 26, 2025, a family of four, residing in Campos Lindos, Tocantins, returned to Brazil by road after spending approximately one month in Bolivia (4). The primary case (the father, case 1) developed a rash on July 2 and was initially suspected of dengue fever at a local healthcare facility. His wife and two children (cases 2, 3, and 4) developed symptoms 10 days after the onset of the rash in case 1. They sought no medical care. The index case was identified from case 5, the family’s niece, who developed a rash on July 15 and sought medical care two days later. The measles case was then reported to the municipal surveillance service and, the following day, to the Tocantins State Health Department and the Ministry of Health. Given the risk of measles reintroduction in Brazil, the ongoing outbreak in Bolivia, and the travel history of the measles cases, a rapid and coordinated response was initiated in the three levels of governance (municipal, state, and federal) to investigate the local outbreak and implement control measures.The epidemiological investigation found additional suspected cases among contacts of the primary case and their relatives, indicating potential transmission (as they were susceptible). Case 1 was laboratory-confirmed for measles by serology and polymerase chain reaction on July 18 and classified as imported. However, it was impossible to determine whether infections in cases 2, 3, and 4 were acquired during their stay in Bolivia or by contact with case 1 after returning to Brazil; therefore, they were classified as import-related cases.In total, 26 cases were reported, of which one was discarded and 25 were confirmed over the 70-day surveillance period, with the highest incidence occurring in July 2025 (Figure 1). Among confirmed cases, 14 occurred in male patients (56%). The median age was 15 years, ranging from 1 to 30 years. Moreover, two cases required hospitalization. Both recovered.Figure 1Confirmed measles cases and administered doses of measles-containing vaccines according to date of rash onset, Campos Lindos, Tocantins State, Brazil, 2025 6 , 7 (data obtained on December 23, 2025). Of the confirmed cases, 13 (52%) were confirmed by detectable polymerase chain reaction, two (8%) by reactive IgM serology, and 10 (40%) by epidemiological linkage due to the impossibility of sample collection. Samples with detectable polymerase chain reaction were sequenced, identifying genotype D8, lineage MVs/Ontario.CAN/47.24 (DSId 9171), consistent with documented viral circulation during the same period in Bolivia, Mexico, the United States, and Canada, confirming case importation.The transmission chain analysis showed that 84% (22) of the cases occurred in members of the traditional Russian-origin community known as the “Old Believers” (referred locally as “Russians”), of whom 91% had no record of measles vaccination. In total, three cases occurred in the general population of the municipality, including a health professional who provided care to the primary case and had no vaccination history. The other two cases, an infant and an adult, were also unvaccinated, and in both instances the source of infection could not be determined.Considering the suspected cases and their initially asymptomatic contacts, 189 individuals were traced and monitored (Figure 2)12, mostly from the local commerce sector and health services, via home visits or telephone follow-up. The monitoring period spanned 30 days after the last exposure to a confirmed case for asymptomatic contacts or until the onset of signs and symptoms compatible with measles - at which point they were then considered suspected cases.Figure 2Transmission network of measles cases obtained from epidemiological investigation and contact tracing (Go.Data). Campos Lindos, Tocantins State, Brazil, 2025 8 , 12 (data up to November 4, 2025, subject to change).The investigation indicated that the outbreak began after the return of the primary case from Bolivia, with subsequent transmission to family members and a health professional, who generated new transmission chains. This study found the transmission chain for 22 (91.6%) secondary cases. However, it was impossible to identify any possible contact with confirmed cases for two cases from the general population.Before the outbreak, the municipality had vaccination coverage of 123.33% for the first dose (D1) and 76.67% for the second dose (D2) in children aged under two years. Intensified vaccination activities targeting individuals aged six months to 59 years began after notification of the index case (case 5), including ring vaccination and vaccination sweep activities. Members of the Old Believers community received 17 doses, 27.9% of the estimated population (61 individuals) residing in urban and rural areas of the municipality.Given the successive identification of cases, vaccine hesitancy within the Old Believers community, low D2 vaccination coverage, and the risk of sustained transmission in Brazil, a selective vaccination intensification strategy was implemented throughout the municipality to create a protective “cocoon” for individuals adhering to vaccination. Meetings were also held with health managers from four municipalities in Tocantins to strengthen awareness regarding surveillance and vaccination intensification in the region. DISCUSSIONThe measles outbreak in Campos Lindos, Tocantins, involved 25 cases, concentrated among unvaccinated individuals from a traditional Russian-origin community (Old Believers) following viral reintroduction associated with international travel. Timely outbreak investigation, laboratory confirmation, and immunization strategies interrupted viral transmission.The rapid increase in vaccination coverage was decisive in interrupting transmission and preventing the expansion of the outbreak to other municipalities. Vaccination coverage exceeding 100% likely reflects an underestimation of the population denominator stemming from the registration of live births in other municipalities, a common situation in locations without maternity healthcare services, such as Campos Lindos.The adopted vaccination intensification strategies, based on intensive vaccination of populations surrounding identified cases and susceptible individuals, established a protective immunological buffer. Conceptually, this approach corresponds to “ring vaccination,” which aims to create zones of immunity around confirmed cases, interrupting further spread beyond the initial focus of transmission 13 . These strategies may be applied preventively (before epidemics occur) and in containment during outbreaks aiming to limit disease propagation 13 , 14 .The outbreak was declared over after 12 weeks without new cases, on December 5, 2025, contributing to the maintenance of measles elimination in Brazil. The control of this outbreak stemmed from integrated strategies between the three levels of Brazilian Unified Health System governance and implemented actions in other municipalities in the Tocantins State and in a neighboring state. CONCLUSIONSOld Believers communities maintain distinct religious practices, strong internal cohesion, rural and domestic lifestyles, and lower daily circulation in collective or public environments 15 . These communities occur in municipalities in Mato Grosso, Parana, and Goias states and in countries such as Bolivia, the United States, and Canada. Intense people interaction occurs between these communities, including via marriages, which increases the group’s transnational mobility. The investigated outbreak showed a high proportion of unvaccinated individuals and resistance to vaccination. Mobility between countries with active viral circulation, low vaccination coverage, and strong interaction within members of the community contributed to the increase in case numbers. Similar situations have been described in outbreaks among Amish communities and other groups with low vaccination adherence in North America 16 , 17 .The outbreak showed the high transmissibility of the virus in susceptible populations and the risk of viral reintroduction in Brazil by international travelers. The retrospective identification of the primary case highlights the need for sensitive surveillance systems capable of early detection, immediate response, and appropriate differential diagnoses. Ring vaccination proved to be an effective strategy in contexts of vaccine hesitancy to contain transmission. Municipalities should, therefore, identify pockets of susceptible individuals, vaccinate them, and, when necessary, adopt this approach to contain further disease spread. In July 2025, a measles outbreak occurred in the municipality of Campos Lindos, Tocantins State, after the return of a family from Bolivia, a country with active measles transmission 4 . Although the municipality had a predominantly vaccinated population, cases were concentrated in a specific group. full_text_sections.abstract: ABSTRACTAfter the recertification of measles elimination in Brazil, outbreaks associated with imported cases may occur in pockets of susceptible individuals, including communities with low vaccination coverage. This study describes an outbreak investigation conducted in 2025 in Campos Lindos, Tocantins State, Brazil. In total, 25 cases were confirmed, mostly among unvaccinated Old Believers (a traditional community of Russian origin) following viral introduction linked to international travel, with transmission occurring predominantly within the community. Outbreak response measures, including ring vaccination and active case finding, interrupted transmission after 12 weeks with no new cases. The rapid response was effective and reinforces the importance of identifying susceptibility pockets in the population to prevent measles reintroduction.KEYWORDS: Disease outbreaks, Measles, Vaccine hesitancy, Public health surveillance.
full_text_sections.methods: MATERIALS AND METHODSA descriptive study was conducted among residents of Campos Lindos, a located in Tocantins State, northern Brazil (13°02’S, 46°46’W), with an economy predominantly based on agriculture and an estimated population of 8,653 inhabitants in 2025 5 . This study describes the outbreak, including the affected population, immunization aspects, surveillance activities, laboratory investigation, and prevention and control measures. Analysis ranged from July 18 to September 9, 2025, with retrospective case findings from June 18 onward and surveillance extending up to December 15 due to the international 12-week period required after the last reported case.This epidemiological investigation included interviews with suspected and confirmed cases, clinical sample collection, contact tracing and monitoring, active community case finding, review of medical records from the two Brazilian Unified Health System health services in the municipality, immunization activities, and training of health professionals. This investigation aims to identify the disease, the source of infection, and its transmission chain and to implement measures to control the outbreak and prevent community transmission.To control the outbreak and prevent new cases, immunization activities using measles-containing vaccines (MMR, MMRV, or MR) were carried out in individuals aged six months to 59 years according to the National Immunization Schedule. The strategies included (a) ring vaccination within 72 h after contact with suspected or confirmed cases, (b) vaccination sweep around confirmed cases (covering a minimum radius of five blocks in urban areas or five properties in rural areas), and (c) intensification of vaccination across the entire municipal population.To analyze vaccination in the context of the outbreak, vaccine doses administered from July to December 2025 in all age groups were considered according to records from the National Health Data Network 6 . Municipal vaccination coverage was evaluated in children aged 1 to <2 years following guidance from the Brazilian Ministry of Health, using the number of vaccinated children in this age group × 100 as the numerator and the corresponding estimated population as the denominator.Data were obtained from the Notifiable Diseases Information System 7 , the Laboratory Environment Manager, the Citizen Electronic Health Record, and the National Health Data Network vaccination dashboard. Descriptive analyses were performed using Microsoft Office, and the transmission chain was constructed on Go.Data 8 . Case definitions from the Brazilian Health Surveillance Guide were adopted 9 , and control actions followed Brazilian Ministry of Health protocols for outbreak response 10 , 11 .Ethical aspects followed the provisions of Law No 8,080/1990 (which regulates epidemiological surveillance actions in Brazil) and Resolution No 510 of April 7, 2016, of the National Health Council as this was an outbreak investigation conducted exclusively in response to an imminent public health risk, according to Brazilian regulations for public health surveillance activities. The confidentiality of those involved in the investigation was ensured (no individual identification).

papers.title_original: Measles outbreak in a unique sociocultural context: epidemiological investigation and control measures in Northern Brazil, 2025

analysis.research_question_and_background: The study aimed to investigate a measles outbreak in a unique sociocultural context and evaluate the effectiveness of control measures in preventing further transmission.
analysis.study_design_and_population: A descriptive study was conducted in Campos Lindos, a municipality in Tocantins State, northern Brazil, with an estimated population of 8,653 inhabitants in 2025. The outbreak involved 25 confirmed cases, predominantly among unvaccinated Old Believers, a traditional Russian-origin community, following viral introduction linked to international travel.
analysis.methods: The investigation included interviews with suspected and confirmed cases, clinical sample collection, contact tracing and monitoring, active community case finding, review of medical records from two Brazilian Unified Health System health services, immunization activities, and training of health professionals. Samples with detectable polymerase chain reaction were sequenced to identify the genotype of the measles virus.
analysis.main_results: A total of 25 cases were confirmed over a 70-day surveillance period, with the highest incidence occurring in July 2025. Of these, 13 were confirmed by polymerase chain reaction, two by reactive IgM serology, and 10 by epidemiological linkage. The measles virus genotype D8, lineage MVs/Ontario.CAN/47.24, was identified, consistent with documented viral circulation in Bolivia, Mexico, the United States, and Canada. The transmission chain analysis showed that 84% of the cases occurred within the Old Believers community, of whom 91% had no record of measles vaccination.
analysis.interpretation_and_novelty: The outbreak highlighted the high proportion of unvaccinated individuals and resistance to vaccination within the Old Believers community, as well as the risk of viral reintroduction in Brazil by international travelers. The findings underscore the importance of targeted vaccination strategies in preventing sustained transmission.
analysis.scientific_and_public_health_significanc: The study provides insights into the challenges of measles control in communities with low vaccination coverage and vaccine hesitancy, emphasizing the need for sensitive surveillance systems and tailored immunization strategies to prevent outbreaks and protect vulnerable populations.
analysis.limitations_and_evidence_strength: The study's retrospective nature and reliance on self-reported vaccination records may introduce bias. The evidence is moderate, as the findings are based on surveillance data and community-based interventions, with some limitations in determining the exact source of infection for certain cases.

analysis.summary_en: This study investigated a measles outbreak in Campos Lindos, Tocantins, Brazil, which primarily affected unvaccinated members of the Old Believers community, a traditional Russian-origin group. The outbreak was linked to international travel, and the measles virus genotype D8 was identified, consistent with circulation in Bolivia, Mexico, the United States, and Canada. The investigation involved interviews, contact tracing, and active case finding, revealing high transmission rates within the community due to low vaccination adherence. Intensified vaccination strategies, including ring vaccination and outreach efforts, were implemented to create an immunological buffer. The study highlights the challenges of measles control in culturally distinct communities with vaccine hesitancy and underscores the importance of targeted surveillance and immunization. However, the retrospective nature of the data and reliance on self-reported vaccination records limit the confidence in the findings, resulting in a moderate evidence assessment.

elements_zh.research_question_and_background: 该研究旨在在独特的社会文化背景下调查 麻疹 传播 并评估控制措施在预防进一步 传播 方面的有效性。
elements_zh.study_design_and_population: 在巴西北部托坎廷斯州坎波斯林多斯市进行了一项描述性研究,该市到 2025 年估计人口为 8,653 人。暴发 涉及 25 例确诊病例,其中主要是未接种疫苗的老信徒社区,这是一个传统的俄罗斯裔社区,病毒传播与国际旅行有关。
elements_zh.methods: 调查包括采访疑似和确诊病例、临床样本收集、接触者追踪和监测、积极的社区病例发现、审查巴西统一卫生系统两个卫生服务机构的医疗记录、免疫活动以及卫生专业人员的培训。对具有可检测聚合酶链反应的样品进行测序,以鉴定 麻疹病毒 的基因型。
elements_zh.main_results: 在 70 天的 监测 期间,总共确诊了 25 例病例,最高的 发病率 发生在 2025 年 7 月。其中,13 例通过聚合酶链反应确诊,2 例通过反应性 IgM 血清学 确诊,10 例通过流行病学连锁确诊。鉴定出 麻疹病毒 基因型 D8,谱系 MVs/Ontario.CAN/47.24,与玻利维亚、墨西哥、美国和加拿大记录的病毒传播一致。传播链分析显示,84%的病例发生在老信徒社区内,其中91%的人没有麻疹 疫苗接种的记录。
elements_zh.interpretation_and_novelty: 暴发 强调了老信徒社区内未接种疫苗的个人比例很高以及对 疫苗接种 的抵抗力,以及国际旅行者在巴西重新引入病毒的风险。研究结果强调了有针对性的 疫苗接种 策略在预防持续 传播 方面的重要性。
elements_zh.scientific_and_public_health_significanc: 该研究深入了解了 麻疹 覆盖率低和 疫苗 犹豫不决的社区中 麻疹 控制的挑战,强调需要敏感的 监测 系统和量身定制的免疫策略来预防 暴发 并保护弱势群体。
elements_zh.limitations_and_evidence_strength: 该研究的回顾性和对自我报告 疫苗接种 记录的依赖可能会引入偏差。证据是中等的,因为研究结果是基于 监测 数据和基于社区的干预措施,在确定某些病例的确切感染源方面存在一些局限性。

papers.full_text: New York has just declared a state of emergency as measles cases continue to rise. So far this year, the US has recorded 3,887 cases of measles, the highest annual total since 1991. That is about 70% more cases than were recorded during the whole of 2025. In November, the Pan American Health Organization will review whether the US has lost the measles elimination status it has held since 2000. Cases are one thing, but the number of deaths is more complicated. A dispute has developed between the state of Pennsylvania and federal health officials over how many people have died. Pennsylvania, where the outbreak has reached 1,004 cases, has reported five measles-related deaths since late August. But the Centers for Disease Control and Prevention (CDC) has counted two measles deaths nationally in 2026. The CDC has not said where those two deaths occurred, so it is unclear whether either is among the five reported in Pennsylvania. No other state has reported measles deaths this year. What the argument is about Part of the disagreement comes down to how a measles-related death is defined. Pennsylvania counts a death as measles-associated if the person had a laboratory-confirmed measles infection and died within 30 days of developing symptoms, unless there is another clear cause of death, such as a car crash. The state says it based its definition on national definitions used for deaths from flu and RSV (a common respiratory infection). The CDC adds a death only once its National Center for Health Statistics has verified that measles was listed as the underlying cause. So there is no agreed national definition of a measles death, though the CDC says that it is working on one. The two approaches can produce different answers in difficult cases, and Pennsylvania has had several. The Lancaster County coroner concluded that a newborn who tested positive for measles died of a lacerated spleen and that measles did not contribute. The same coroner found that a second infant, who had a rare and usually fatal genetic condition, did die of measles. In a third case, the Mifflin County coroner attributed an 18-year-old’s death to acute disseminated encephalomyelitis, a rare and severe neurological complication of measles – so, a confirmed measles-related death. But the dispute has not stayed technical. The CDC initially included the first two Pennsylvania deaths, then removed them after the US Health Secretary, Robert F. Kennedy Jr, questioned whether measles had caused them. Leaving out deaths reported by a state is a departure from the agency’s usual practice. The count matters to both sides: more deaths strengthen the case for vaccination, fewer fit the view that the risk is overstated. RFK Jr, who has for years questioned vaccines but describes himself as “pro-safety” rather than anti-vaccine, has accused politicians of exaggerating the threat from infectious diseases to frighten the public. He also suggested that the Pennsylvania deaths may have been “fabricated by one of the Governor’s hopeful staffers”. Pennsylvania’s Democratic governor Josh Shapiro says Kennedy’s actions and the administration’s rhetoric are harming communities across America. The state has threatened to withdraw a request for CDC outbreak support unless the deaths are recognised – a move the federal health department has described as “political blackmail” Why the count matters These are Pennsylvania’s first measles deaths in 35 years, from a vaccine-preventable disease the US declared eliminated in 2000. The fact that measles deaths are happening again shows how far the country has moved from the situation it had achieved through vaccination. That makes the dispute over how many people have died more than a technical argument about definitions. Andrew Pavia of the Infectious Diseases Society of America said the effect of this dispute is confusing the public and undermining trust in the CDC. And this confusion has the biggest impact where vaccination rates are lowest. Measles is so contagious that a community needs more than 95% of people vaccinated to stop it spreading. Below that, outbreaks take hold, and the people most at risk are those who cannot protect themselves, such as babies too young for the vaccine, which is normally given at 12 to 15 months. Across the US, MMR coverage is lower among children who are uninsured or on Medicaid, living below the poverty line or living in rural areas. Averages also hide local gaps. In Lancaster County, 88% of pupils were vaccinated against measles last school year, against 97% across Pennsylvania. These are the communities where clear information about risk matters most. When official figures conflict, it is harder to tell people how serious an outbreak is, and harder to make the case for sending staff and vaccines their way. The UK lost its own elimination status in January, and a child died of measles in Liverpool in July 2025. Only 85% of five-year-olds in England have had both MMR doses, against a 95% target. Coverage also follows deprivation: in 2016-17 England’s most deprived areas had slightly higher MMR coverage than the least deprived, by 2024-25 they were 7.6 percentage points behind. In both countries, health services need accurate, consistent figures to know where those gaps are so protection reaches everyone in proportion to need What would help? full_text_sections.full_text: New York has just declared a state of emergency as measles cases continue to rise. So far this year, the US has recorded 3,887 cases of measles, the highest annual total since 1991. That is about 70% more cases than were recorded during the whole of 2025. In November, the Pan American Health Organization will review whether the US has lost the measles elimination status it has held since 2000. Cases are one thing, but the number of deaths is more complicated. A dispute has developed between the state of Pennsylvania and federal health officials over how many people have died. Pennsylvania, where the outbreak has reached 1,004 cases, has reported five measles-related deaths since late August. But the Centers for Disease Control and Prevention (CDC) has counted two measles deaths nationally in 2026. The CDC has not said where those two deaths occurred, so it is unclear whether either is among the five reported in Pennsylvania. No other state has reported measles deaths this year. What the argument is about Part of the disagreement comes down to how a measles-related death is defined. Pennsylvania counts a death as measles-associated if the person had a laboratory-confirmed measles infection and died within 30 days of developing symptoms, unless there is another clear cause of death, such as a car crash. The state says it based its definition on national definitions used for deaths from flu and RSV (a common respiratory infection). The CDC adds a death only once its National Center for Health Statistics has verified that measles was listed as the underlying cause. So there is no agreed national definition of a measles death, though the CDC says that it is working on one. The two approaches can produce different answers in difficult cases, and Pennsylvania has had several. The Lancaster County coroner concluded that a newborn who tested positive for measles died of a lacerated spleen and that measles did not contribute. The same coroner found that a second infant, who had a rare and usually fatal genetic condition, did die of measles. In a third case, the Mifflin County coroner attributed an 18-year-old’s death to acute disseminated encephalomyelitis, a rare and severe neurological complication of measles – so, a confirmed measles-related death. But the dispute has not stayed technical. The CDC initially included the first two Pennsylvania deaths, then removed them after the US Health Secretary, Robert F. Kennedy Jr, questioned whether measles had caused them. Leaving out deaths reported by a state is a departure from the agency’s usual practice. The count matters to both sides: more deaths strengthen the case for vaccination, fewer fit the view that the risk is overstated. RFK Jr, who has for years questioned vaccines but describes himself as “pro-safety” rather than anti-vaccine, has accused politicians of exaggerating the threat from infectious diseases to frighten the public. He also suggested that the Pennsylvania deaths may have been “fabricated by one of the Governor’s hopeful staffers”. Pennsylvania’s Democratic governor Josh Shapiro says Kennedy’s actions and the administration’s rhetoric are harming communities across America. The state has threatened to withdraw a request for CDC outbreak support unless the deaths are recognised – a move the federal health department has described as “political blackmail” Why the count matters These are Pennsylvania’s first measles deaths in 35 years, from a vaccine-preventable disease the US declared eliminated in 2000. The fact that measles deaths are happening again shows how far the country has moved from the situation it had achieved through vaccination. That makes the dispute over how many people have died more than a technical argument about definitions. Andrew Pavia of the Infectious Diseases Society of America said the effect of this dispute is confusing the public and undermining trust in the CDC. And this confusion has the biggest impact where vaccination rates are lowest. Measles is so contagious that a community needs more than 95% of people vaccinated to stop it spreading. Below that, outbreaks take hold, and the people most at risk are those who cannot protect themselves, such as babies too young for the vaccine, which is normally given at 12 to 15 months. Across the US, MMR coverage is lower among children who are uninsured or on Medicaid, living below the poverty line or living in rural areas. Averages also hide local gaps. In Lancaster County, 88% of pupils were vaccinated against measles last school year, against 97% across Pennsylvania. These are the communities where clear information about risk matters most. When official figures conflict, it is harder to tell people how serious an outbreak is, and harder to make the case for sending staff and vaccines their way. The UK lost its own elimination status in January, and a child died of measles in Liverpool in July 2025. Only 85% of five-year-olds in England have had both MMR doses, against a 95% target. Coverage also follows deprivation: in 2016-17 England’s most deprived areas had slightly higher MMR coverage than the least deprived, by 2024-25 they were 7.6 percentage points behind. In both countries, health services need accurate, consistent figures to know where those gaps are so protection reaches everyone in proportion to need What would help? A couple of practical steps could help. A national definition of a measles death, agreed in advance and applied the same way everywhere, would take the question out of individual disputes. Publishing basic details of each counted death, such as state and age group, would let anyone reconcile federal and state figures. Neither requires anyone to concede a wider political argument. There are encouraging signs on vaccination. By mid-July, Pennsylvania’s state health staff had given more than three times as many MMR doses in Lancaster County as in the whole of 2025. And the UK shows that elimination can be won back, having lost its status in 2018 and regained it again in 2021. If the US loses its status in November, that will describe the past year, rather than decide the next one. Closing the local coverage gaps is what matters most, and it is easier when everyone is working from the same numbers.

analysis.research_question_and_background: The study addresses the growing measles outbreak in the US and the lack of consensus on the number of deaths attributed to the disease, highlighting the need for a standardized definition of measles-related mortality.
analysis.study_design_and_population: The study reports on the measles outbreak in the US, focusing on the state of Pennsylvania and the national CDC efforts, with data collected from January to October 2026.
analysis.methods: The study describes the methods used by Pennsylvania and the CDC to define and count measles-related deaths, including criteria for laboratory-confirmed infections and verification by the National Center for Health Statistics.
analysis.main_results: Pennsylvania reported five measles-related deaths since late August 2026, while the CDC counted only two nationally. The CDC has not disclosed the locations of these deaths, and no other states have reported measles deaths this year.
analysis.interpretation_and_novelty: The discrepancy in death counts reflects differing definitions of measles-related mortality, with Pennsylvania using a broader approach and the CDC requiring measles as the underlying cause, indicating a need for a unified national definition.
analysis.scientific_and_public_health_significanc: Accurate and consistent death counts are crucial for assessing outbreak severity, guiding public health responses, and reinforcing the importance of vaccination in preventing measles transmission and mortality.
analysis.limitations_and_evidence_strength: The evidence is limited by the lack of a national definition for measles deaths and the potential for political influence on reporting, resulting in a moderate confidence assessment.

analysis.summary_en: This study examines the measles outbreak in the US, particularly in Pennsylvania, and highlights the disagreement between state and federal health officials over the number of measles-related deaths. Pennsylvania has reported five deaths, while the CDC has only counted two nationally, without specifying locations. The discrepancy arises from differing definitions of measles-related mortality, with Pennsylvania using a broader criteria and the CDC requiring measles as the underlying cause. The study underscores the importance of a unified national definition to improve public health responses and vaccination efforts. The lack of a standardized approach and potential political influence on reporting limit the confidence in the findings, suggesting a moderate evidence strength. The implications of this disagreement extend to public trust and the effectiveness of outbreak management, especially in areas with lower vaccination rates.

papers.title: Multiple Sclerosis and Viruses: « Liaisons Dangereuses ».
papers.abstract: ABSTRACT Multiple sclerosis (MS) is a complex, multifactorial neurodegenerative disease with an aetiology that is still partially elusive. Several risk factors are associated with MS development including genetic predisposition and various environmental stressors; however, recently, viral infections have gained significant attention as a crucial environmental trigger. Despite the well‐established link between Epstein‐Barr virus (EBV) and MS susceptibility, a single‐pathogen model fails to clearly characterise the molecular cascades driving the disease, suggesting that the transition from infection to autoimmune response involves more than one viral agent. In this review we examine the speculation that the interactions among different neurotropic viruses could serve a collective causative role in MS, which is under‐researched in the literature at present. We summarise contradictory evidence on the role of different viral agents, including the Herpesviridae family (Human Cytomegalovirus, EBV, Herpes Simplex Viruses HSV‐1 and HSV‐2, and Varicella Zoster Virus), Paramyxoviridae family (Measles Virus and Rubella Virus), Influenza virus, SARS‐CoV‐2, and Human Endogenous Retroviruses (HERVs). Through interplay within shared molecular pathways, immune modulation, and activation of latent infections, these viruses may collectively influence the inflammatory and demyelinating processes that characterise MS. This review evaluates the etiological role of viral interplay in MS through the cumulative and interactive effects of these pathogens. The available epidemiological, immunological, and experimental data converge on the concept that viral co‐exposures act synergistically to shape MS susceptibility in genetically predisposed individuals. Characterising these viral interactions presents a new research direction for the identification of novel biomarkers and the development of preventative strategies through the targeted control of viral networks.

analysis.scope_and_question: The review explores the potential role of viral interactions in the etiology of multiple sclerosis (MS), with a focus on the measles virus as a target entity. It examines how viral co-exposures may synergistically influence MS susceptibility in genetically predisposed individuals.
analysis.evidence_base_and_review_method: The review is a systematic analysis of the literature, incorporating epidemiological, immunological, and experimental data. It evaluates the collective causative role of viral interplay in MS, particularly focusing on the measles virus and its interactions with other pathogens.
analysis.consensus_and_key_conclusions: The review concludes that viral co-exposures, including the measles virus, may act synergistically to shape MS susceptibility in genetically predisposed individuals. It highlights the need to understand the molecular mechanisms underlying these interactions.
analysis.controversies_and_evidence_gaps: There is contradictory evidence regarding the role of different viral agents in MS. The review identifies gaps in understanding the specific molecular pathways and immune mechanisms by which the measles virus and other pathogens influence the disease.
analysis.research_and_practice_implications: The review suggests that characterising viral interactions presents a new research direction for identifying novel biomarkers and developing preventative strategies through targeted control of viral networks.

analysis.summary_en: This review investigates the potential role of measles virus and other neurotropic viruses in the etiology of multiple sclerosis (MS). It highlights the complex interplay between viral co-exposures and genetic predisposition, suggesting that these interactions may synergistically influence MS susceptibility. Despite the well-established link between Epstein-Barr virus (EBV) and MS, the review indicates that a single-pathogen model is insufficient to explain the disease's molecular mechanisms. The findings underscore the need for further research into the collective effects of viral agents and their interactions, as well as the development of targeted strategies for prevention and treatment. The review also identifies gaps in the current evidence, particularly regarding the specific pathways and immune mechanisms involved in these interactions.

elements_zh.controversies_and_evidence_gaps: 关于不同病毒因子在多发性硬化症中的作用存在相互矛盾的证据。该综述确定了在理解 麻疹病毒 和其他病原体影响疾病的特定分子途径和免疫机制方面的差距。
elements_zh.research_and_practice_implications: 该综述表明,表征病毒相互作用为识别新型生物标志物和通过有针对性地控制病毒网络制定预防策略提供了一个新的研究方向。

papers.abstract_zh: 摘要 多发性硬化症(MS)是一种复杂的、多因素的神经退行性疾病,其病因仍部分难以捉摸。多种风险因素与多发性硬化症的发生有关,包括遗传倾向和各种环境压力因素;然而,最近,病毒感染作为一个重要的环境触发因素受到了广泛关注。尽管 Epstein-Barr 病毒 (EBV) 和 MS 易感性之间存在明确的联系,但单一病原体模型无法清楚地描述驱动该疾病的分子级联反应,这表明从感染到自身免疫反应的转变涉及不止一种病毒因子。在这篇综述中,我们研究了这样的推测:不同嗜神经病毒之间的相互作用可能在多发性硬化症中发挥集体致病作用,目前文献对此研究不足。我们总结了关于不同病毒因子作用的相互矛盾的证据,包括疱疹病毒科(人类巨细胞病毒、EBV、单纯疱疹病毒HSV-1和HSV-2以及水痘带状疱疹病毒)、副粘病毒科(麻疹病毒和风疹病毒)、流感病毒、SARS-CoV-2和人内源性逆转录病毒(HERV)。通过共享分子途径、免疫调节和潜在感染激活之间的相互作用,这些病毒可能共同影响多发性硬化症的炎症和脱髓鞘过程。本综述通过这些病原体的累积和相互作用效应评估了病毒相互作用在多发性硬化症中的病因学作用。现有的流行病学、免疫学和实验数据集中在这样一个概念上:病毒共同暴露协同作用,影响遗传易感个体的多发性硬化症易感性。表征这些病毒相互作用为识别新型生物标志物和通过有针对性地控制病毒网络制定预防策略提供了新的研究方向。

papers.title: Interferon-induced OASL restricts ADAR1 p150 RNA binding and A-to-I RNA editing
papers.abstract: The interferon (IFN)-inducible RNA editor ADAR1 p150 catalyzes adenosine-to-inosine (A-to-I) editing of host and viral double-stranded RNAs, limiting aberrant innate immune sensing and regulating gene expression. How ADAR1 p150 activity is regulated during host-virus interactions remains poorly understood. Here, we identify the IFN-stimulated gene OASL as an inhibitor of ADAR1 p150. OASL engages p150 through two distinct interactions: its N-terminal OAS domain associates with the RNA-binding domains in an RNA-dependent manner, whereas its C-terminal ubiquitin-like domains bind the Zα domain independently of RNA. Despite their distinct canonical functions, the OAS and ubiquitin-like domains converge to limit ADAR1 p150 RNA binding and suppress A-to-I editing across the transcriptome. OASL also reverses p150-mediated suppression of antiviral and innate immune gene expression and counteracts p150-mediated enhancement of measles virus and vesicular stomatitis virus replication. Thus, OASL restrains ADAR1 p150, linking interferon signaling to the control of RNA editing and antiviral immunity.

papers.title: Vaccination in Children with Paediatric Autoimmune and Autoinflammatory Rheumatic Diseases: Evidence on Safety, Immunogenicity and Effectiveness Across Live-Attenuated, mRNA and Recombinant Vaccines
papers.abstract: Vaccination in children with paediatric autoimmune and autoinflammatory rheumatic diseases (pedAIIRDs) is clinically important but challenging. These children have an increased risk of infections due to both their underlying immune-mediated disease and the immunosuppressive therapies required for disease control. At the same time, immunosuppression may reduce vaccine-induced immune responses, while concerns about disease flares and the safety of live-attenuated vaccines may result in delayed or incomplete vaccination. This thesis aimed to generate clinically applicable, real-world evidence on the safety, immunogenicity and effectiveness of vaccination in children with pedAIIRDs receiving immunosuppressive therapy. Five studies addressed three vaccine platforms: the live-attenuated measles-mumps-rubella (MMR) booster vaccine, COVID-19 mRNA vaccines and the recombinant zoster vaccine (RZV; Shingrix). In a cohort of 186 children with juvenile idiopathic arthritis (JIA), MMR booster vaccination was not associated with increased disease activity, including in children receiving biological disease-modifying antirheumatic drugs, and no serious vaccine-related adverse events were observed. Long-term evaluation of 182 children with JIA showed that most patients maintained protective antibodies against measles, mumps and rubella. However, measles seroprotection five years after vaccination was significantly lower in patients receiving biologic therapy at vaccination than in those not receiving biologics, supporting a targeted approach to serological monitoring. A systematic review and meta-analysis demonstrated that COVID-19 vaccination was associated with a marked reduction in the risk of multisystem inflammatory syndrome in children (MIS-C). In a prospective cohort of 157 children with paediatric rheumatic diseases, COVID-19 mRNA vaccination induced humoral responses in nearly all patients and adequate T-cell responses in most tested patients. Although antibody concentrations were lower in patients receiving biologic therapy, vaccine effectiveness against symptomatic COVID-19 was preserved. No increase in disease activity, myocarditis or serious adverse events was identified. Finally, off-label use of RZV was evaluated in ten varicella-zoster-virus-naïve immunocompromised children for whom live-attenuated varicella vaccination was unsuitable. Nine of ten patients seroconverted following two doses. Two subsequently developed mild breakthrough varicella after household exposure and recovered without hospitalisation or antiviral treatment. Together, these studies support a shift from broad vaccine avoidance towards individualised, treatment-specific vaccination strategies in immunocompromised children. The findings provide evidence for the safe use of selected live vaccines, targeted monitoring of long-term vaccine-induced immunity, effective use of mRNA vaccines and further evaluation of non-live vaccine alternatives. These results may contribute to future national and international vaccination recommendations for children with immune-mediated inflammatory diseases.
